title: Great but…
body:
Please start from scratch on the stats section. There’s barely any useful info. I’d like to know how often am I failing this bad habit. I get a line that doesn’t appear to move mixed in with a bunch of other lines. That’s nonsense I don’t need. I need the numbers not nonsense graphs unless we can compare between 1, 3, 6 & 12 months and also remove all the lines from things we don’t need to look at. Are you getting what I’m saying? Great app but stats section is a huge fail. Moved to ⭐️⭐️⭐️ because they’re not listening to me. Next time I come back we gonna drop to 2 stars sucka. 

Please fix stats section. Yearly graph with the yearly overview has two shades of purple that blend together almost seamlessly, making them hard to distinguish making that chart very useless. The stats graph at the bottom needs help too. I’ll have like 4 goals with a very similar shade of turquoise, but then only like two turquoise data lines on the graph. So less data lines than there are habits to be tracked. This could be really helpful if you can fix it so habits and their data are distinguishable from all others otherwise I’ll see a turquoise line, and I can’t tell which habit it goes to or where the lines are for the habits without them. I need stats to motivate me to move forward and I need stats to encourage and motivate me when I slip or fail. That’s the real purpose of these. Look at your own app devs and look at your section and ask yourself “is this data in this section motivating me and inspiring me to push harder?” The app really is great. I’m on social security & already had a lifetime version to another app but now I use this one exclusively. Fix the stats, find a way to inspire, motivate and push us towards success if our goals with better stats. I could give a whole wish list of stuff that could make this better but honestly it really is so great already so I just have that 1 section to criticize. Oh and at the bottom I will say there’s a button for a share section… that’s a prominent button spot for a feature %99 of customers won’t use. Gotta put something better there that is more useful to everyone. Maybe you’ll interstate AI and put that button there instead.

body:
This app is miles better than any other habit tracking app i’ve tried (and i’ve tested a TON). It’s one app i don’t mind paying for. Well worth the rave reviews. However, there is a major bug i’ve noticed. 

When pulling in data from some (not all) categories in Apple Health, the number of DAILY DATA ENTRIES is recognized, and not the ACTUALLY DATA. 

For instance, I tried to bring in weight data. When I checked the Grit app for updates, I saw recorded:

“1/185 lbs, 170lbs”

instead of

“170/185lbs”

Then, when I manually inputted another data entry in the Apple Health app, to my disappointment I saw “2/185 lbs, 170lbs”

Obviously this greatly skews how I track completion percentages, and trends overall. Don’t know if this is user error, but would love to see this resolved soon.

title: Nearly Perfect…
body:
I’ve been using Grit for a short time, and it has quickly become one of my favorite productivity tools. The app’s design is sleek, intuitive, and highly customizable, making it easy to track habits and stay on top of my goals. I especially love the ability to set specific goals and track progress over time—it’s a game-changer for habit-building.

However, the one area where Grit falls just short of perfection is the lack of support for non-repeatable, one-time tasks. While the app excels at habit tracking, it would be incredibly useful to have the ability to add one-off tasks that don’t factor into the overall habit metrics. This functionality would consolidate all my to-do items into one app and eliminate the need for other tools like Apple’s Notes.

This minor shortcoming is the only thing keeping Grit from being a perfect five-star, daily-use application for me. With the addition of non-repeatable tasks, this app would truly be unbeatable.

Despite this, I can’t recommend Grit enough—it’s a fantastic tool for anyone looking to take control of their habits and achieve their goals. Here’s hoping this already great app continues to get even better!

Rating: ★★★★☆

   I wanted an option to match the dark mode with the system dark color of the native Apple widgets (reminders and calendar). I try to stick to stock apps unless there’s a real problem I feel they can’t solve. But the true black was a little harsh next to my other apps. Such a minor thing but they did it and it made me happy! 

I genuinely feel excited to use this app and love how my home screen looks perfect now. 

To the dev, thank you so much!

title: Almost perfect! Minor fix needed
body:
This is the perfect app to keep an adhd individual on track. I love that I can set goals for different parts of the day and categorize them as well as location based goals. The color coding that can be personalized is extremely helpful, as well. The habit tracker with graph charts are helpful to see trends, I like this feature even as someone I would not consider “math minded.” I’ve tried many habit tracking apps and while each has its perks, this is the one I’ve returned to and actually deemed worth the year investment, and then some. This app is easily worth more than they ask for! My one and only complaint is that it lacks the ability to set goals for specific days, and not others. Other reviews have mentioned this con, and I agree. I wish to set specific days for things such as the gym or a specific household chore, work task etc. If this ability is added in future updates I shall amend my review to state that this is absolute perfection.

Edit: yes you can set a weekly habit but you’re unable to select the specific day, it stays in your list of tasks to do until you “check” it off and that’s defeating the purpose of trying to check off everything in one day. Having the ability to mark a specific task to show up on the list only on Mondays or Tuesdays would be absolutely helpful!
